data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage
agent_assumptions: Room/corridor representative boundaries placed at evidenced face dimensions (3000mm room depth, 1500mm corridor clear width); 250mm wall thickness declared as metadata only, not as an added gap.
F1 interior partitions at x=5 and x=10 derived from south-facade dimension chain closure (exact to 15000mm) and cross-checked against pixel measurement of partition pillars.
F1 room-to-corridor door positions read from top-row arcs; bottom-row door positions assumed to mirror top row (not independently measured per-door).

F2 four bottom offices assumed equal width (3.75m each); South elevation dimension chain actually suggested unequal widths (outer rooms wider, ~5.31m, with narrower ~2.19m middle rooms) which was not resolved within budget - flagged as unresolved.
F2 office door positions approximated at room centers; not individually measured.
Window sill/head heights inferred from North_view elevation dimension chain (800 head clearance, 1800 window height) applied consistently to F1 and F2; exact match only confirmed for F2.
No staircase / vertical circulation element was identified or modeled within the time budget; connectivity between F1 and F2 is otherwise unresolved.
East facade: ground+upper floor windows at corridor. West facade: upper floor window, ground floor door (secondary entrance) at corridor, per West_view.png icon shape (door vs window).
unresolved: Exact F2 bottom-row (4 offices) partition widths - south elevation chain suggests asymmetric widths not matching equal quarters used here.
Small closet/nook drawn inside F1_R4 (bottom-left room) not modeled as a separate cell; treated as furniture.
Precise per-door widths/positions for many interior doors are approximated, not individually measured from arcs.
Staircase/vertical circulation not located in supplied drawings within budget.
